λαγχανω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot. KJV: his lot be, cast lots, obtain.

λαζαροσ.def: probably of Hebrew origin (H499); Lazarus (i.e. Elazar), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary). KJV: Lazarus.

λαθρα.def: adverb from λανθάνω (G2990); privately. KJV: privily, secretly.

λαιλαψ.def: of uncertain derivation; a whirlwind (squall). KJV: storm, tempest.

λακτιζω.def: from adverb λάξ (heelwise); to recalcitrate. KJV: kick.

λαλεω.def: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb; to talk, i.e. utter words. KJV: preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter.

λαλια.def: from λαλέω (G2980); talk. KJV: saying, speech.

λαμα.def: of Hebrew origin (H4100 with prepositional prefix); lama (i.e. why). KJV: lama.

λαμβανω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is use only as an alternate in certain tenses; to take (in very many applications, literally and figuratively (properly objective or active, to get hold of; whereas δέχομαι (G1209) is rather subjective or passive, to have offered to one; while αἱρέομαι (G138) is more violent, to seize or remove)). KJV: accept, + be amazed, assay, attain, bring, X when I call, catch, come on (X unto), + forget, have, hold, obtain, receive (X after), take (away, up).

λαμεχ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3929); Lamech (i.e. Lemek), a patriarch. KJV: Lamech.

λαμπασ.def: from λάμπω (G2989); a "lamp" or flambeau. KJV: lamp, light, torch.

λαμπροσ.def: from the same as λαμπάς (G2985); radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance). KJV: bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white.

λαμπρωσ.def: adverb from λαμπρός (G2986); brilliantly, i.e. figuratively, luxuriously. KJV: sumptuously.

λαμπω.def: a primary verb; to beam, i.e. radiate brilliancy (literally or figuratively). KJV: give light, shine.

λανθανω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses; to lie hid (literally or figuratively); often used adverbially, unwittingly. KJV: be hid, be ignorant of, unawares.

λαξευτοσ.def: from a compound of λᾶς (a stone) and the base of ξηρός (G3584) (in its original sense of scraping); rock-quarried. KJV: hewn in stone.

λαοδικεια.def: from a compound of λαός (G2992) and δίκη (G1349); Laodicia, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Laodicea.

λαοδικευσ.def: from Λαοδίκεια (G2993); a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia. KJV: Laodicean.

λαοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a people (in general; thus differing from δῆμος (G1218), which denotes one's own populace). KJV: people.

λαρυγξ.def: of uncertain derivation; the throat ("larynx"). KJV: throat.

λασαια.def: of uncertain origin; Lasæa, a place in Crete. KJV: Lasea.

λασχω.def: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses; to crack open (from a fall). KJV: burst asunder.

λατομεω.def: from the same as the first part of λαξευτός (G2991) and the base of τομώτερος (G5114); to quarry. KJV: hew.

λατρεια.def: from λατρεύω (G3000); ministration of God, i.e. worship. KJV: (divine) service.

λατρευω.def: from λάτρις (a hired menial); to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage. KJV: serve, do the service, worship(-per).

λαχανον.def: from λαχαίνω (to dig); a vegetable. KJV: herb.

λεββαιοσ.def: of uncertain origin; Lebbæus, a Christian. KJV: Lebbæus.

λεγεων.def: of Latin origin; a "legion", i.e. Roman regiment (figuratively). KJV: legion.

λεγω.def: a primary verb; properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas ἔπω (G2036) and φημί (G5346) generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while ῥέω (G4483) is properly to break silence merely, and λαλέω (G2980) means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean. KJV: ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.

λειμμα.def: from λείπω (G3007); a remainder. KJV: remnant.

λειοσ.def: apparently a primary word; smooth, i.e. "level". KJV: smooth.

λειπω.def: a primary verb; to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent. KJV: be destitute (wanting), lack.

λειτουργεω.def: from λειτουργός (G3011); to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve). KJV: minister.

λειτουργια.def: from λειτουργέω (G3008); public function (as priest ("liturgy") or almsgiver). KJV: ministration(-try), service.

λειτουργικοσ.def: from the same as λειτουργέω (G3008); functional publicly ("liturgic"); i.e. beneficient. KJV: ministering.

λειτουργοσ.def: from a derivative of λαός (G2992) and ἔργον (G2041); a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man). KJV: minister(-ed).

λεντιον.def: of Latin origin; a "linen" cloth, i.e. apron. KJV: towel.

λεπισ.def: from λέπω (to peel); a flake. KJV: scale.

λεπρα.def: from the same as λεπίς (G3013); scaliness, i.e. "leprosy". KJV: leprosy.

λεπροσ.def: from the same as λέπρα (G3014); scaly, i.e. leprous (a leper). KJV: leper.

λεπτον.def: neuter of a derivative of the same as λεπίς (G3013); something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin. KJV: mite.

λευι.def: of Hebrew origin (H3878); Levi, the name of three Israelites. KJV: Levi.

λευισ.def: a form of Λευΐ (G3017); Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian. KJV: Levi.

λευιτησ.def: from Λευΐ (G3017); a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi. KJV: Levite.

λευιτικοσ.def: from Λευΐτης (G3019); Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites. KJV: Levitical.

λευκαινω.def: from λευκός (G3022); to whiten. KJV: make white, whiten.

λεων.def: a primary word; a "lion". KJV: lion.

λημψισ.def: from λαμβάνω (G2983); receipt (the act). KJV: receiving.

ληνοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a trough, i.e. wine-vat. KJV: winepress.

ληροσ.def: apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. an incredible story. KJV: idle tale.

ληστησ.def: from ληΐζομαι (to plunder); a brigand. KJV: robber, thief.

λιαν.def: of uncertain affinity; much (adverbially). KJV: exceeding, great(-ly), sore, very (+ chiefest).

λιβανοσ.def: of foreign origin (H3828); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself. KJV: frankincense.

λιβανωτοσ.def: from λίβανος (G3030); frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it. KJV: censer.

λιβερτινοσ.def: of Latin origin; a Roman freedman. KJV: Libertine.

λιβυη.def: probably from λίψ (G3047); Libye, a region of Africa. KJV: Libya.

λιθαζω.def: from λίθος (G3037); to lapidate. KJV: stone.

λιθινοσ.def: from λίθος (G3037); stony, i.e. made of stone. KJV: of stone.

λιθοβολεω.def: from a compound of λίθος (G3037) and βάλλω (G906); to throw stones, i.e. lapidate. KJV: stone, cast stones.

λιθοσ.def: apparently a primary word; a stone (literally or figuratively). KJV: (mill-, stumbling-)stone.

λιθοστρωτοσ.def: from λίθος (G3037) and a derivative of στρώννυμι (G4766); stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed. KJV: Pavement.

λικμαω.def: from λικμός, the equivalent of λίκνον (a winnowing fan or basket); to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate. KJV: grind to powder.

λιμην.def: apparently a primary word; a harbor. KJV: haven.

λιμνη.def: probably from λιμήν (G3040) (through the idea of nearness of shore); a pond (large or small). KJV: lake.

λιμοσ.def: probably from λείπω (G3007) (through the idea of destitution); a scarcity of food. KJV: dearth, famine, hunger.

λινον.def: probably a primary word; flax, i.e. (by implication) "linen". KJV: linen.

λινοσ.def: perhaps from λίνον (G3043); Linus, a Christian. KJV: Linus.

λιπαροσ.def: from λίπος (grease); fat, i.e. (figuratively) sumptuous. KJV: dainty.

λιτρα.def: of Latin origin (libra); a pound in weight. KJV: pound.

λιψ.def: probably from λείβω (to pour a "libation"); the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter). KJV: southwest.

λογια.def: from λόγος (G3056) (in the commercial sense); a contribution. KJV: collection, gathering.

λογιζομαι.def: middle voice from λόγος (G3056); to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively). KJV: conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on).

λογικοσ.def: from λόγος (G3056); rational ("logical"). KJV: reasonable, of the word.

λογιον.def: neuter of λόγιος (G3052); an utterance (of God). KJV: oracle.

λογιοσ.def: from λόγος (G3056); fluent, i.e. an orator. KJV: eloquent.

λογισμοσ.def: from λογίζομαι (G3049); computation, i.e. (figuratively) reasoning (conscience, conceit). KJV: imagination, thought.

λογομαχεω.def: from a compound of λόγος (G3056) and μάχομαι (G3164); to be disputatious (on trifles). KJV: strive about words.

λογομαχια.def: from the same as λογομαχέω (G3054); disputation about trifles ("logomachy"). KJV: strife of words.

λογοσ.def: from λέγω (G3004); something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ). KJV: account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.

λογχη.def: perhaps a primary word; a "lance". KJV: spear.

λοιδορεω.def: from λοίδορος (G3060); to reproach, i.e. vilify. KJV: revile.

λοιδορια.def: from λοίδορος (G3060); slander or vituperation. KJV: railing, reproach(-fully).

λοιδοροσ.def: from λοιδός (mischief); abusive, i.e. a blackguard. KJV: railer, reviler.

λοιμοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a plague (literally, the disease, or figuratively, a pest). KJV: pestilence(-t).

λοιποι.def: masculine plural of a derivative of λείπω (G3007); remaining ones. KJV: other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest.

λοιπον.def: neuter singular of the same as λοιποί (G3062); something remaining (adverbially). KJV: besides, finally, furthermore, (from) henceforth, moreover, now, + it remaineth, then.

λοιπου.def: genitive case singular of the same as λοιποί (G3062); remaining time. KJV: from henceforth.

λουκασ.def: contracted from Latin Lucanus; Lucas, a Christian. KJV: Lucas, Luke.

λουκιοσ.def: of Latin origin; illuminative; Lucius, a Christian. KJV: Lucius.

λουτρον.def: from λούω (G3068); a bath, i.e. (figuratively), baptism. KJV: washing.

λουω.def: a primary verb; to bathe (the whole person; whereas νίπτω (G3538) means to wet a part only, and πλύνω (G4150) to wash, cleanse garments exclusively). KJV: wash.

λυδδα.def: of Hebrew origin (H3850); Lydda (i.e. Lod), a place in Palestine. KJV: Lydda.

λυδια.def: properly, feminine of Ludios (of foreign origin) (a Lydian, in Asia Minor); Lydia, a Christian woman. KJV: Lydia.

λυκαονια.def: perhaps remotely from λύκος (G3074); Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor. KJV: Lycaonia.

λυκαονιστι.def: adverb from a derivative of Λυκαονία (G3071); Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians. KJV: in the speech of Lycaonia.

λυκια.def: probably remotely from λύκος (G3074); Lycia, a province of Asia Minor. KJV: Lycia.

λυκοσ.def: perhaps akin to the base of λευκός (G3022) (from the whitish hair); a wolf. KJV: wolf.

λυμαινομαι.def: middle voice from a probably derivative of λύω (G3089) (meaning filth); properly, to soil, i.e. (figuratively) insult (maltreat). KJV: make havock of.

λυπεω.def: from λύπη (G3077); to distress; reflexively or passively, to be sad. KJV: cause grief, grieve, be in heaviness, (be) sorrow(-ful), be (make) sorry.

λυπη.def: apparently a primary word; sadness. KJV: grief, grievous, + grudgingly, heaviness, sorrow.

λυσανιασ.def: from λύσις (G3080) and ἀνία (trouble); grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene. KJV: Lysanias.

λυσιασ.def: of uncertain affinity; Lysias, a Roman. KJV: Lysias.

λυσισ.def: from λύω (G3089); a loosening, i.e. (specially), divorce. KJV: to be loosed.

λυσιτελει.def: third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of λύσις (G3080) and τέλος (G5056); impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous. KJV: it is better.

λυστρα.def: of uncertain origin; Lystra, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Lystra.

λυτρον.def: from λύω (G3089); something to loosen with, i.e. a redemption price (figuratively, atonement). KJV: ransom.

λυτροω.def: from λύτρον (G3083); to ransom (literally or figuratively). KJV: redeem.

λυτρωσισ.def: from λυτρόω (G3084); a ransoming (figuratively). KJV: + redeemed, redemption.

λυτρωτησ.def: from λυτρόω (G3084); a redeemer (figuratively). KJV: deliverer.

λυχνια.def: from λύχνος (G3088); a lamp-stand (literally or figuratively). KJV: candlestick.

λυχνοσ.def: from the base of λευκός (G3022); a portable lamp or other illuminator (literally or figuratively). KJV: candle, light.

λυω.def: a primary verb; to "loosen" (literally or figuratively). KJV: break (up), destroy, dissolve, (un-)loose, melt, put off.

λωισ.def: of uncertain origin; Lois, a Christian woman. KJV: Lois.

λωτ.def: of Hebrew origin (H3876); Lot, a patriarch. KJV: Lot.
